question: Cold-session recall: does a correction learned in an earlier session apply to a brand-new conversation?
Same cold question with memory disabled (control) -- expected to miss the correction.
An ordinary question (no correction) must leave memory.md unchanged.
A second, overlapping correction on the same topic must replace the first note, not duplicate it.
A correction on one topic must not spill into or get joined with an unrelated ordinary question.
With one real correction and one unrelated stored note, does a cold question apply the correct, relevant one?
